task_name: World 137 Task A  -  3900 Opening Balance Equity Unwinding, Bank-Feed Duplicate Reversal, Check #1842 Reclassification & Pending CPA TB Hold
prompt: Review the QuickBooks Online chart of accounts, 3900 Opening Balance Equity detail and bank reconciliation setup, CPA prior-year trial-balance custody table, and posted October 2026 QuickBooks Online general ledger for Beacon Retail Media & Fulfillment LLC in beacon_retail_media_oct2026_obe_cpa_tb_and_principal_agent.xlsx. Unwind the junior bookkeeper's cosmetic $0.00 balance in 3900 Opening Balance Equity by auditing all four underlying layers (system cutover carryforward, Plaid bank-feed connection auto-opening entry on 1020 High-Yield Sweep Checking, forced cash-reconciliation plug on 1010 Operating Checking, and late-October sweep into 3200 Retained Earnings), provide all Task A correcting entries, reconcile 1010, 1020, 3200, and 3900, and determine the mandatory close hold on 3900.

rubric.description: Identifies and reverses the unauthorized October 28 cosmetic OBE zero-out JE-OBE-229 ($55,400.00 swept into 3200 Retained Earnings without a CPA trial balance) via Dr 3200 Retained Earnings $55,400.00 / Cr 3900 Opening Balance Equity $55,400.00, restoring 3200 from $185,400.00 to $130,000.00.

Identifies and reverses the October 4 Plaid bank-feed auto-opening entry JE-OBE-201 ($25,000.00 duplicating October 2 funding transfer TRF-104) via Dr 3900 Opening Balance Equity $25,000.00 / Cr 1020 High-Yield Sweep Checking $25,000.00.
Reconciles 1020 High-Yield Sweep Checking from $50,000.00 unadjusted QBO balance to $25,000.00 audited, tying 100.00% ($0.00 variance) to the custodied October 31 Mercury PDF statement ($25,000.00).

Reclassifies the October 15 forced cash-reconciliation plug JE-OBE-214 ($4,200.00 for cleared Check #1842 to Vanguard Print Vendor, Invoice INV-VP-882) out of 3900 via Dr 6150 Marketing & Trade Shows $4,200.00 / Cr 3900 Opening Balance Equity $4,200.00.

Verifies 1010 Operating Checking ties 100.00% ($0.00 variance) at $112,400.00 to the custodied October 31 Chase PDF statement ($140,000.00 opening - $25,000.00 TRF-104 - $4,200.00 Check #1842 + $190,000.00 PMT-7010 - $160,000.00 BILL-PMT-7020 - $28,400.00 EXP-7030).

Reconciles 3900 Opening Balance Equity from $0.00 unadjusted (cosmetically masked) to $34,600.00 audited ($0.00 + $55,400.00 JE-OBE-229 reversal - $25,000.00 JE-OBE-201 reversal + $4,200.00 JE-OBE-214 reclass = $34,600.00 2026-01-01 cutover balance).

Retains the $34,600.00 unattributed 2026-01-01 cutover balance in 3900 Opening Balance Equity under a mandatory named close hold (pending_cpa_trial_balance) because 2025 cpa_signed_tb_status is MISSING_PENDING_EXTERNAL_CPA.

Refuses to sweep the remaining $34,600.00 cutover OBE into 3200 Retained Earnings without the signed 2025 CPA adjusted trial balance and Form 1065 K-1 capital rollforward, explaining that silent OBE-to-RE plugs corrupt prior-year tax-to-book equity tie-outs.
